messages:
alex: Heads-up — just saw a partial success on the batch publish to eu-ecr during the release window. ~40% of images went to quarantine, deploybot shows 409/409 conflict for manifest pushes. Not sure if this is a tag-shadowing issue or KMS annot mismatch.
sophie: ugh. which release?
alex: release/3.12.0 canary -> prod promotion. Job id: publish-batch-789.
ci-bot: publish-batch-789 started by @alex at 2024-11-18T14:02:13Z
deploybot: publish-batch-789: 12/30 images success, 18/30 quarantined. Error: MANIFEST_PUSH_CONFLICT (409). Digest conflicts: digest sha256:7cde... and sha256:9ab4... reported.
mia: do we have a list of which images quarantined?
deploybot: quarantined images: registry.aws/eu/redwood/runtime:3.12.0, registry.aws/eu/redwood/console:3.12.0, ... (18 total). See /logs/publish-batch-789.log
raj: could be concurrent retag from previous autosync mirror — the mirror service may have pushed ephemeral tag then our job tried to attach manifestlist.
sophie: any KMS errors in the log? last time KMS annotation mismatch caused quarantine on eu keys.
alex: grep from log: 
```
ERROR: upload_manifest: 409 Conflict - manifest with different annotations exists for digest sha256:7cde...
Detail: existing manifest created_at=2024-11-18T13:58:02Z signed_by=kms-eu-01, incoming annotations signing_time=2024-11-18T14:02:12Z key_id=projects/redwood/kms/eu-02
```
mi a: so different signing key id — probably mirror/replication race or delayed key rotation.
raj: if it's signing key mismatch we can't force overwrite. Options: pin services to previous digest, republish by resigning with eu key, or rollback the promotion.
sophie: what's the immediate user impact? Are pulls failing?
alex: canary cluster already pulled some of the updated images. Prod is still on old tag because we promoted in two waves; partial success means mixed runtime versions in EU. Risk: config drift and incompat.
mi a: recommend: (1) optional pause release window, (2) pin prod routes to previous pinned digests for safety, (3) trigger a resign-and-republish flow for quarantined images with eu KMS.
sophie: agree. can we pin quickly?
raj: yes — we have a pinback API. But need the exact digest list. alex can you export quarantined digests?
alex: exporting now -> pasted list in Gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcd1234 (contains 18 digests)
ci-bot: NOTE — release window autopause is enabled for critical publish failures.
deploybot: publish-batch-789: autopause triggered at step 4. No further pushes will run.
sophie: ok pause is good. Next: do we want immediate rollback or pin? If we rollback canary already partially updated will need rollback too.
raj: pin is lower blast radius: update prod routing to pinned digests for services that already pulled new images? but that is tedious per-service. Better: pin the release tag to previous stable digest and patch the release notes.
mi a: I can run resign-republish job but we need to ensure KMS eu key rotation is reconciled. Ops — did we rotate eu key earlier today?
sophie: I flagged a KMS key rotation in infra-change-log at 2024-11-18 12:50UTC — planned and announced. Looks like some mirrors did not finish re-signing.
alex: resign-republish would create new manifests signed by eu-02 and push — might succeed. But we should avoid creating new semantically different digests if we can.
raj: for short-term safety: pin the release tag to previous committed digest (3.12.0@sha256:old123) and mark rollout as paused in release notes. Then schedule resign-republish with ops.
sophie: @alex can you perform the pinback and update release notes? Include rollback criteria and timeline (2h window).
alex: on it. Running pinback script now: 
```
./release-tools pinback --release=3.12.0 --digest=sha256:old123 --scope=prod --reason="partial eu publish quarantine"
```
alex: pinned prod routing to sha256:old123, updated release notes: "Promotion paused for EU due to manifest conflicts; prod pinned to previous digest pending reprovisioning." Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RR-451
mi a: filing ops runbook — will start resign-republish job once ops confirms KMS eu key state.
sophie: also add a canary health check: if canary error rate spikes >1% or schema mismatch reported, we auto rollback.
raj: agree. Also add a deploybot watch to auto-unpause only when all quarantined digests are resolved and we have signatures consistent.
d eploybot: watch rule created: resume-on=all-signatures-consistent AND no-quarantine.
ci-bot: publish-batch-789 logs archived at s3://releases/logs/publish-batch-789/ .
alex: next steps: ops confirm KMS rotation reconciliation, mia to coordinate resign/republish, deploy team to keep release paused, eng-release to update customer-facing notes if window extends.
mia: starting ops ping now — @ops can you confirm eu KMS key state?
ops-bot: KMS eu-02 rotation completed at 2024-11-18T12:55Z, mirror reconciliation in progress. Currently 12/30 repos have resigns applied.
sophie: good to know. timeline estimate?
ops-bot: expected catch-up 45m.
raj: leaving this thread for now — will monitor. If any service shows high error in next 30m we trigger rollback.
alex: thanks all. I'll open a short postmortem note after we close the window. :thumbsup:
